name: Consonite Needles

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves

disable: DC 20 Acrobatics check or DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to Squeeze or reach carefully through the gaps between the needles.

items.name: Needle Fall
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches any consonite needle

---

Effect The needle snaps, and the vibrations resonate with some of the surrounding needles. The falling minerals deal 2d8+7 untyped damage to creatures within a 5-foot burst surrounding the triggering individual (DC 22 basic Reflex save save). The needle fall doesn't involve every consonite growth within these squares, so can be triggered again from the same location.

text: Consonite forms needle-like stalactites that can easily break free if touched, setting off a chain reaction that threatens to pierce anyone who stands in the area.
